_comment: Fallback WildChat prompt bank (20 prompts). The paper sampled 20 prompts from WildChat-1M (Zhao et al., 2024) but does not publish which 20. The first three here are the verbatim examples quoted in Appendix B; the rest are hand-written in the same everyday-knowledge-question style (mostly factual/how-to, no roleplay/fiction, matching the paper's stated exclusion). To use the real dataset instead, set WILDCHAT_USE_DATASET=1 and prompts.py will sample from allenai/WildChat-1M via the datasets library. See DESIGN.md.
